description: Restore a custom theme's code to an earlier commit (Pro plan; free on every plan until 2027-01-01). It is saved as a new commit, so the rollback itself can be undone; on the live theme it goes live once compiled. Without commit, restores the version before the latest change.

theme_id.description: A theme id from theme_list (or the system theme id lokand-base)

name: theme_rollback
title: Theme rollback
